description: Command injection vulnerability in the web server input validation of certain Hikvision IP camera models allowing remote code execution via specially crafted messages.
Improper authentication vulnerability in certain Hikvision IP cameras allowing unauthenticated users to obtain device configuration snapshots.
Identity authentication bypass vulnerability in some Dahua products during network packet authentication allowing unauthorized access to services.
ONVIF WS-UsernameToken authentication replay vulnerability in certain Dahua cameras allowing unauthorized configuration read.
Unauthenticated command injection vulnerability in the web management interface country locale parameter.
Remote code execution vulnerability in web service goform/setUsbUnload parameter via buffer overflow.
Denial of service and information disclosure vulnerability in the web server of Cisco ASA and RV-series routers.
Improper error message handling in the IKE packet parser leading to remote command execution on firewall gateways.
